scope.actual_review: Reread full listed handler/helper bodies and direct local algorithms; shared API/descriptor clauses reused from prior frozen review with exact excerpts. No live source/Lean/native evidence.
scope.unit_policy: Original88 lineage records; source_call_alias explicitly marked with call/delegation line and null replacementanchors. Shared action group names actual stage,not canonical N. Recursion is a source recurrence edge,not unbounded copies.
scope.normalization_boundary: Source guards/actions under explicit pinned library/virtual interfaces. Complex loop programs remain source code blocks with structured step/line descriptions,not executable extracted guards or verified semantic models.

constructors: hlo_creation_utils .cc absent; actual typed constructor arguments and status/value/deref handling retained.
analysis: ShapeUtil/CommonFactors/IndexUtil/layout/ArraySize/ByteSize/literal recognizers retained as pinned source library operations; selected algorithms inspected,not verified expansion.
callbacks: Visitor TargetReshapeIsBitcast,IsValidLayout,UpdateLayout backend overrides; actual calls/default where inspected pinned.
module_and_metadata: Recovery-table method implementation absent; actual effect order pinned. CopyOriginalValue projection and SetupDerivedInstruction bodies inspected,underlying tree/metadata APIs retained.
global_caller: Whole-pass postorder/fixedpoint/preemption,verifier domain,async reachability,RNG/effect observation and error recovery remain separate from local branch normalization.

unreviewed_source_extent: Other399 frozen source IDs outside THIS batch; prior85+56 normalization artifacts separate.

representation_contract.line_numbers: one-basedinclusive,exact source_text and SHA256 for every referenced span
representation_contract.order: handler stage_ids ordered; per-case predecessors require CONTINUATION not raw-test negation

matcher-transaction.actual_behavior: Default Match preflights the WHOLE pattern with capture=false, then runs it with capture enabled only after success. A failed whole Match does not alter capture pointers. A successful Match followed by a false C++ conjunct DOES retain captures.

compatible-existing.actual_behavior: Reject nonempty old control predecessors or !SameShape. Otherwise visitor existing replacement preserve_sharding=true, preserve_frontend_attributes=true, then StatusOr.value(): false may continue, non-OK value access is fatal rather than propagated handler Status.

visitor-new.actual_behavior: Default preserve_sharding=false, relay_controls=false, remove_unused=true, preserve_frontend_attributes=true. Calls computation-new; any OK marks changed=true, including low-level unchanged/skip OK.

visitor-existing.actual_behavior: Existing replacement relays controls=true, remove_unused=true; explicit preserve flags. StatusOr overload ORs changed with returned bool. Status overload uses preserve_sharding=false, DCHECKs successful bool, returns status.

computation-new.actual_behavior: AddInstruction(new) occurs BEFORE low-level replacement. Relay=false may return unchanged because old has controls; DCHECK(changed), returns OK in builds without assertion failure. Allocation survives rejection; visitor marks changed on OK.

computation-existing.actual_behavior: Requires compatible shapes, sharding skip only if preserve_sharding=true, relay/copy/drop control path or no-relay controlled-old skip. Copies metadata/original values/sharding/frontend attrs under source guards, rewires users/root, removes old and unused operands. Status failures do not provide transactional rollback.

operand-rewire.actual_behavior: Requires CompatibleIgnoringFpPrecision; checks bounds; same pointer returns OK; otherwise updates operand/user lists. Does not relay controls/delete old producer or mark visitor changed by itself.

MakeConcatHlo-boundary.actual_behavior: Declared creation API adds Concatenate in common computation; operands nonempty and same computation; default metadata/frontend attrs null. Caller propagates StatusOr. Exact implementation not bundled.
limits: Callee implementation absent in frozen packet; source call and status boundary are enumerated.

MakeScalarLike-boundary.actual_behavior: Template creates R0 literal of native value, Convert(base element_type).value(), then MakeScalarLikeFromLiteral. Preserve the typed conversion and opaque shape-conforming helper boundary; do not silently replace it by a real scalar of arbitrary precision.
limits: MakeScalarLikeFromLiteral implementation absent in frozen packet.

CreateConstantWithLayoutUpdated.actual_behavior: CreateConstant(move literal), virtual UpdateLayout(constant.mutable_shape), return unique_ptr. Actual scalar/array literal shape is retained except layout update.

UpdateLayout-virtual.actual_behavior: Virtual source extension point for Shape pointer; default packs subbyte element sizes via ShapeUtil::UpdateElementSizeInBits(shape,true). A subclass can override; preserve dynamic dispatch boundary and actual target object (new/local Shape here).

operand-access.actual_behavior: operand(i) directly indexes operands_[i]; mutable_operand directly indexes and CHECKs nonnull. No rank/arity guard is added by the handler before DUS operand2 access.

MakeSliceHlo-boundary.actual_behavior: Declared StatusOr Slice construction in operand computation; actual typed input/start/limit/stride arrays retained; body absent, errors propagated.
